topic: Scheduling AFA scripts and reporting frequency
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on the deployment and scheduling of AFA scripts. [me] confirmed that a script was developed and launched on the same day. Regarding the required reporting cycle, it was noted that the client currently requests reports every two weeks on Mondays. However, [me] proposed changing this to weekly reporting, suggesting a daily job schedule for the automation. This approach would allow for both bi-weekly reporting and provide overlap/redundancy.
decisions: AFA scripts were developed and launched by [me].
The reporting frequency was discussed, with a proposal to move from bi-weekly to weekly reports.
